title: Pi-shaped MF
text: Pi-shaped membership function, 1 input, 1 output; {Left base point a} sets the foot of left transition area, {Left top point b} sets the shoulder of left transition area, {Right top point c} sets the shoulder of right transition area and {Right base point d} sets the foot of right transition area. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Left base point a
params.values: Foot of left transition area -9 (default) | scalar

params.name: Left top point b
params.values: Shoulder of left transition area -7 (default) | scalar

params.name: Right top point c
params.values: Shoulder of right transition area -9 (default) | scalar

params.name: Right base point d
params.values: Foot of right transition area -7 (default) | scalar
